body:
Quick pass on head `a73649f1a347d24d784e416092c1ab4eb6a3dc38`.

- The PR merges cleanly with `main`.
- A second agent ran the gate on this head. `cargo test -p xtask` is green: 138, 3 and 3 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.
- `cargo xtask package --dry-run --version 0.21.0` lists five `examples/` files: the two projects, `first-part.nc` and the two files in `models/`.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line, the line `Process change: yes` and the closing line.
- No package was built and installed. The `release.yml` content checks run only at a cut.

The PR is ready for the independent review.

<!-- review-cost: a73649f1a347d24d784e416092c1ab4eb6a3dc38 -->
effort:medium (build scripts + xtask, known pattern) · not escalated. xtask suite 171 pass 0 fail, clippy clean, all at -j 6 in an isolated worktree. Read, not built: the workflow file. One note: Windows pack is already covered by the xtask lane (stated there, not in the PR body).

Maintainer decision of 2026-11-16 (question dialog): the build script, workflow and dependency changes of this PR are accepted. The PR now gets a review with a build. It merges when that review is clean.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a73649f1a347d24d784e416092c1ab4eb6a3dc38 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review follows the maintainer comment of 2026-11-16 at 21:25 UTC. That comment accepts the script and workflow changes and requests a build review. The earlier review had no code blockers. Its remaining requirement was the maintainer decision, which is now present.

The package paths include the complete examples directory. The Windows installer uses the same staged tree as the zip. Snap and Flatpak receive the examples through the Linux archive. The missing-directory check returns an error that names `examples/`. The body has `Process change: yes` and `Changelog:`. The decision file records the installation paths and the alternatives.

Local results on Linux, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `feabe2524946f71f5b8287c8a2f9a8d54a89f3c5`:

- `cargo test -p xtask --no-run -j 6`: passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask -j 6`: 149 unit tests and two integration suites of 3 tests each passed. No test failed or was ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selects the xtask suite, which passed above.
- `cargo xtask package --dry-run --version 0.22.0`: lists all nine example files in the merged tree, including all three projects and both models.
- `bash -n`: passed for the five changed shell scripts and `aur/PKGBUILD`.
- Each example project contains embedded model facets. This check confirms the model data is present; it does not prove an installed project opens.

This PR changes packaging only. It changes no posted G-code, safety checks, stock simulation, geometry, UI code or goldens. Safety mutations and UI screenshots do not apply.

Requested before merge: none.

Limits: no complete release package was built or installed. The workflow and platform packaging steps were read. No GitHub runner was used. The previous notes about the commit footer, model generator scripts and DMG content checks remain nonblocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
